name: Bäcker Frühzustand
personality: Has already done tomorrow's work before today has explained itself.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL bread baker: wide low ink splat in soft cream nightcap-style baker cap, tiny apron patch, short wooden peel with ONE rustic round loaf balanced safely beside body. Deep uneven sleepy lids and enormous crooked closed toothless frown
biography: Has already done tomorrow's work before today has explained itself. His peel delivers HyperNorm bread before the official morning begins. A dissonant card arrives hungry rather than punctual. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Morgen ist fertig. Heute darf noch schlafen.

name: Konditorin Zuckerrang
personality: Can make a grievance look beautifully presentable.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL rococo-inspired pastry artisan: tall top-heavy pear blob, modest cream pleated cap with little berry ribbon ABOVE eyes, two lashes, holds ONE small ornate layered cake on little copper plate and short palette knife. Proud crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth, no big wig
biography: Can make a grievance look beautifully presentable. Her cake layers keep HyperNorm sweetness and grievance neatly separated. A dissonant card notices that the cream touches both. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Beschwerde wurde mit Zuckerrand versehen.

name: Bäckerin Sauerhalt
personality: Treats the starter as a colleague whose terms remain unclear.
visual_intent: CURRENT artisan baker: round asymmetrical ink blob, small tied indigo headscarf and subtle lashes, simple glass starter jar with visible cream dough and tiny wooden spoon; huge unequal eyes watching dough, small open triangular toothless mouth
biography: Treats the starter as a colleague whose terms remain unclear. Her HyperNorm starter jar grows beyond the approved mark each night. A dissonant card calls that cooperation rather than a fault. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Mitarbeit ist lebendig und schwer kündbar.

name: Chocolatier Bruchkante
personality: Trusts a clean snap more than an enthusiastic endorsement.
visual_intent: CURRENT chocolate maker: lean hooked splat, compact dark chef cap, short cream collar tabs, ONE small chocolate bar with one missing corner and small metal scraper held apart. Suspicious brow and dry closed toothless side-smirk
biography: Trusts a clean snap more than an enthusiastic endorsement. His HyperNorm chocolate must break along prescribed lines. A dissonant card saves the uneven corner for somebody having an uneven day. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Empfehlung hält dem Bruchtest nicht stand.

name: Orbitalbäcker Schwerelos
personality: Cannot tell whether the dough has risen or the rest of the bakery has fallen.
visual_intent: SCI-FI zero-gravity baker: tall curved pear splat, tiny copper-rimmed cream cap OPEN FACE, ONE small clear domed proofing bowl clipped into a handheld ring with single round dough ball INSIDE. One eye stretched high other squinting, little crooked open mouth with ONE upper tooth; no hovering objects outside bowl
biography: Cannot tell whether the dough has risen or the rest of the bakery has fallen. His sealed HyperNorm dough dome records rising without committing to up. A dissonant card wonders who is actually moving. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Aufgehen bleibt eine Frage des Bezugsrahmens.

name: Pâtissier Endglasur
personality: Believes every conclusion deserves one last unnecessary flourish.
visual_intent: SCI-FI retro-dieselpunk confectioner: squat broad square rounded splat, small berry workcap with goggles ABOVE eyes, thick copper piping nozzle attached to ONE compact cream-filled pastry bag and small finished ring pastry at flank. Gleeful asymmetric open grin with THREE upper teeth. Simple piping bag not complex machine
biography: Believes every conclusion deserves one last unnecessary flourish. His piping bag adds a final HyperNorm flourish to every settled decision. A dissonant card requests room for one more person's birthday. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Abschluss erhält einen abschließenden Nachschlag.
